programme.title: Manne Agter Die Potte
programme.desc: 'S1/E5'. By Kapokbos, vernoem na die wilde roosmaryn wat in die Bonnievale-omgewing groei, bied sjef Juan Fourie 'n plaaslike eetervaring met nostalgiese smake by 'n uitsonderlike bestemming.

programme.title: Drukkoker

programme.title: Die Liefde Is 'n Snaakse Ding
programme.desc: 'S1/E5'. Vergeet van 'n drafklub of 'n dating-app, want Schalk en Mandri ken van afsprake opstel. Dié week is dit vier nuwe enkellopendes se beurt. Is hulle bereid om alles te waag of sal hulle eerder nog wag?

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S16/E5'. In die 200ste episode van Huisgenoot Ware Lewensdramas kyk ons na die verhaal van pastoor Albern Martins, beter bekend as die 'Gangster Pastor', wat voor die Blue Downs-landdroshof geskiet is.

programme.title: Aneeka se kombuis
programme.desc: 'S1/E5'. Hierdie week is Aneeka se tannie Rowena in die kombuis! Aneeka maak maklike cranberry & brie-happies, en Rowena deel haar resep vir 'n romerige chicken pesto pasta. Dis vinnig, lekker, en propvol van daai tuis-gevoel.

programme.title: Huis SOS
programme.desc: 'S1/E5'. Die akteurspaar Neels & Eloise Clasen word gehelp om hul kinders se speelkamer op te knap en maak 'n nuwe kamer mooi.

programme.title: Aneeka se kombuis
programme.desc: 'S1/E2'. Rugby is serious business... maar in Aneeka se kombuis is daar altyd plek vir lag en liefde. Sy wys wat sy vir Embrose kook voor 'n wedstryd - van gebakte oats tot magic pasta.

programme.title: Huis SOS
programme.desc: 'S1/E2'. Die voormalige Protea-netbalspeler en TV-aanbieder Vanes-Mari du Toit kry 'n stylvolle en funksionele kantoorruimte.

programme.title: Slim Vang Sy Baas: Musiek
programme.desc: 'S1/E2'. Twee groepe radio-omroepers van die kampusradiostasie MFM spook dit uit teen mekaar om te sien wie moontlik met prysgeld van tot R10 000 kan wegstap.

programme.title: Dorpie-doenlys
programme.desc: 'S1/E2'. Ons kuier op die skilderagtige Montagu - waar warmbronne, historiese straatjies en asemrowende natuur op jou wag. Geniet plaaslike kos, stap op die bergpaaie, gaan op 'n safari en kom ontspan soos net Montagu kan.

programme.title: Manne Agter Die Potte
programme.desc: 'S1/E2'. Die uitvoerende sjef Kevin Grobler lei SCAPE-restaurant op Vrymansfontein in die Paarlse wynland, waar sy kos jou op 'n geurige reis deur die Middellandse See neem.

programme.title: Drukkoker
programme.desc: 'S1/E2'. Die Drukkoker-vennootskappe begin vorm. Lizelle en Nicola moet eerste bewys hulle het wat dit vat om 'n suksesvolle restaurant te bestuur, met net 90 minute om hul spyskaart en konsep te bemeester.

programme.title: Die Liefde Is 'n Snaakse Ding
programme.desc: 'S1/E2'. Die liefde is nie vir Schalk en Mandri 'n grap nie. Hulle stuur twee paartjies op ernstige dates. Een is geketting en die ander dans in die diepkant. Is dié paartjies braaf genoeg of sal hulle net toeskouers van die liefde bly?

programme.title: Kom Ons Braai
programme.desc: 'S11/E8'. Ons gunstelingtydverdryf is nou 'n sosiale eksperiment. Drie paartjies wat mekaar nie ken nie, braai by mekaar en heelwat gebeur om die vuur. En ons praat nie net van die lekker kos nie!

programme.title: Aneeka se kombuis
programme.desc: 'S1/E6'. Jy hoef nie buite te staan vir braaigeure nie! Aneeka maak haar go-to hoenderpita in die kombuis, en oom Ian sluit aan met sy famous oxtail-pot. Dis gaskoeldrank, speserye en stories in Aneeka se kombuis.

programme.title: Huis SOS
programme.desc: 'S1/E6'. Ons besoek Babylonstoren saam met die sangeres Anna Davel, waar sy en aanbieder Leon Gropp leer hoe om 'n tuinpartytjie in styl op te stel.

programme.title: Slim Vang Sy Baas: Musiek
programme.desc: 'S1/E6'. Dis tyd vir Lesch is More en Hektiek om hul musiekkennis te bewys. Wie stap moontlik weg met 'n kontantprys van R10 000?

programme.title: Dorpie-doenlys
programme.desc: 'S1/E6'. Ons neem jou op 'n Oos-Kaapse avontuur! Ontdek die windstil strande van Cannon Rocks, vaar saam met die gety in Kenton-on-Sea, ontspan in Port Alfred, en duik in kultuur en geskiedenis in Grahamstad.

programme.title: Drukkoker

programme.desc: 'S14/E1 of 16 - The Hunchy-Back Of LA Habra'. The buyers try their luck at a new facility in La Habra. Dusty brews himself up an interesting unit, while Kenny weighs the value of childhood memories in selecting a locker.

programme.title: Swamp People
programme.desc: 'S16/E1 - Racing The Storm'. A devastating onslaught of storms and hurricanes threatens the fate of swampers' livelihoods. As dark clouds roll in, Troy unleashes his armada of boats, launching a full assault on the bayou.

programme.title: Swamp People
programme.desc: 'S16/E2 - Snapping Back'. Troy and Pickle take a calculated gamble in the sugarcane fields, Leron and Porkchop defy superstition by venturing into Scary Bayou, an area avoided by most hunters for its eerie reputation.

programme.title: Storage Hunters
programme.desc: 'S4/E6'. Brandon arrives solo to the auction, but still flexes his muscle. The men gamble on an abandoned recording studio having equipment. And a trailer with Civil War items incites the men to wage a bidding war.

programme.title: Storage Hunters
programme.desc: 'S4/E7'. Jesse hopes to find some hidden gems in a bin full of old furniture. Papa Bear goes fishing for profit. Brandon and Lori gamble big on a business in a box and a very special item from Sean.

programme.title: Canadian Pickers
programme.desc: 'S2/E1 - A Jumbo Pick'. Scott and Sheldon come face-to-face with a train bell that might have come from the famed train crash that killed Jumbo the Elephant in the late 1800s.

programme.title: American Godfathers: The Five Families
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - The Last Don'. A decidedly new, more aggressive commitment by law enforcement to 'eradicate' the mafia forces the families to find creative ways to stay in business and out of jail.

programme.title: Mystery Places
programme.desc: 'S1/E10'. Visit a UFO house in Taiwan, the US Air Force aircraft and missile storage and maintenance facility in Tucson, Arizona, then travel to Laos, where settlers use war ammunition as everyday objects.

programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S8/E44 of 50 - The Gaucho's Revenge'. In this competition we pay homage to the cowboys of South America: the Gauchos. Four smiths lasso up their skills to recreate the iconic Gaucho knife.

programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S8/E42 of 50 - Flip The Forge'. In this competition the judges flip the script once again, letting the bladesmiths choose their challenge. Will they take it easy or go big to impress the judges?

programme.title: American Pickers
programme.desc: 'S19/E27 - Junkyard Jewels'. Robbie and Jersey comb through a homewrecker's massive cache of architectural salvage, and Mike is determined to rescue a trio of dented Porsches.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S14/E2 of 16 - The 300th Time's The Charm!'. Ivy dons his bright white lucky sneakers in Van Nuys. Brandi and Lisa's 'friendship' is tested as they go head-to-head on a pair of lockers.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S14/E3 of 16 - You Can Lead A Horse To A Locker'. Barry and Kenny show up in their alternative fuel vehicle. Lisa does her best to break the curse of the bad locker, and Ivy finds some curious denominations.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S14/E4 of 16 - Piles To Go Before I Keep'. Laura takes the reigns alone in Fullerton, and proceeds to outsell Dan. Brandi gets assaulted by her locker, but ultimately drives home a winner.

programme.title: Alone
programme.desc: 'S12/E10 of 10 - Weak Spot'. The remaining three survivalists continue to push their limits, reaching almost a month in the Great Karoo Desert. A participant loses the use of a major tool and all their hope along with it.

programme.title: Mountain Men
programme.desc: 'S14/E4 - Icebreaker'. Bret and Ivy bust through sheets of lake ice to ferry critical equipment to their cabin by boat, Lauro and Virginia use the dog team to haul fresh-cut timber from the forest for a log cabin build.

programme.title: WWII Battles In Colour
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Blitzkrieg'. It took only six weeks for the Nazis to conquer France with tanks, aircraft and troops. Witness the extraordinary success of the Blitzkrieg campaign, through rare footage and first-hand accounts.

programme.title: WWII Battles In Colour
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Barbarossa'. On June 22, 1941, Germany launched Operation Barbarossa, a savage attack on the Soviet Union. Now, newly coluorised film and amateur home movies provide an unprecedented inside look at this brutal conflict.

programme.title: Secrets In The Jungle
programme.desc: 'S1/E7 - Creature Of Lake Eacham'. In Belize, hundreds of smashed up human bones and teeth are found in a cave. More than a thousand cylindrical pipes are discovered in a well in India.

programme.title: Secrets In The Jungle
programme.desc: 'S1/E8 - Stone Secrets Of Kill Island'. Hundreds of bones are found in a reservoir in Guatemala. In Oman, a strange weather pattern is discovered. Giant animal bones in Australia puzzle researchers.

programme.title: El Clasico Legends: Ronaldinho
programme.desc: Ronaldinho. Ronaldinho's finest Clásico came on the 19th of November of 2005. Just one point separated both teams in the table, but the Brazilian proved that the gulf on the pitch was much greater.

programme.title: El Clasico Legends: Andrés Iniesta
programme.desc: Andrés Iniesta. Andrés Iniesta Luján. A normal person that was capable of the extraordinary. A glorious career which was also built, in part, on magical performances in ElClásico.

programme.title: El Clasico Legends: James Rodríguez
programme.desc: James Rodríguez. James Rodríguez forced his way into Real Madrid's history books by virtue of his footballing IQ, his magic on the ball and his ability to impress a hugely demanding fanbase.

programme.title: El Clasico Moments: BAR v RMA 18/19
programme.desc: 'El Clasico Moments - Barcelona vs Real Madrid 2018/19'. A celebration of football's fiercest rivalry, El Clásico. From stunning goals to unforgettable drama, we revisit the clashes that defined generations and shaped legends.

programme.title: El Clasico Moments: BAR v RMA 21/22
programme.desc: 'El Clasico Moments - Barcelona vs Real Madrid 2021/22'. A celebration of football's fiercest rivalry, El Clásico. From stunning goals to unforgettable drama, we revisit the clashes that defined generations and shaped legends.

programme.title: El Clasico Moments: BAR v RMA 08/09
programme.desc: 'El Clasico Moments - Barcelona vs Real Madrid 2008/09'. A celebration of football's fiercest rivalry, El Clásico. From stunning goals to unforgettable drama, we revisit the clashes that defined generations and shaped legends.

programme.title: El Clasico Legends: Ousmane Dembélé
programme.desc: Ousmane Dembélé. During his spell at Barcelona, Ousmane Dembele took part in six LaLiga Clásicos - nine in total - with a record of five wins and four defeats. But two of these fixtures will probably stand out above the rest.

programme.title: El Clasico Legends: Álvaro Arbeloa
programme.desc: Álvaro Arbeloa. Álvaro Arbeloa played a key role in Clásicos, where he was handed the unenviable task of defending the likes of Leo Messi, Neymar Jr, Alexis Sánchez or David Villa down his flank.

programme.title: El Clasico Legends: Gareth Bale
programme.desc: Gareth Bale. Gareth Bale played in LaLiga 11 Clásicos and 15 in total. And despite his numbers against Barcelona not being spectacular, he did score a memorable goal in the 2014 Copa del Rey final.

programme.title: LaLiga HL 21/22: Barcelona v R Madrid
programme.desc: 'LaLiga Santander Highlights - Matchday 10: Barcelona vs Real Madrid'. A tense El Clásico packed with chances and bold play saw Real Madrid edge a determined Barcelona, showcasing intensity and high stakes that define this iconic fixture.

programme.title: LaLiga HL 21/22: R Madrid v Barcelona
programme.desc: 'LaLiga Santander Highlights - Matchday 29: Real Madrid vs Barcelona'. Barcelona delivered a stunning 4-0 win at the Bernabéu, with Aubameyang leading a dominant display that marked a turning point under Xavi and silenced all doubts.

programme.title: LaLiga HL 22/23: R Madrid v Barcelona
programme.desc: 'LaLiga Santander Highlights - Matchday 9: Real Madrid vs Barcelona'. Real Madrid beat Barcelona 3-1 at the Bernabéu, taking control early and sealing the win with a late penalty, handing Barça their first league loss of the season.

programme.title: LaLiga HL 22/23: Barcelona v R Madrid
programme.desc: 'LaLiga Santander Highlights - Matchday 26: Barcelona vs Real Madrid'. In a high-paced Clásico at Camp Nou, Barcelona came from behind to win 2-1, with Kessie netting a dramatic injury-time winner after Asensio's goal was ruled offside.

programme.title: LaLiga HL 23/24: Barcelona v R Madrid
programme.desc: 'LaLiga EA Sports Highlights - Matchday 11: Barcelona vs Real Madrid'. Barcelona took an early lead, but Jude Bellingham's late double turned the tide as Real Madrid snatched a dramatic Clásico win.

programme.title: LaLiga HL 23/24: R Madrid v Barcelona
programme.desc: 'LaLiga EA Sports Highlights - Matchday 32: Real Madrid vs Barcelona'. Barcelona twice took the lead in a tense Clásico, but Real Madrid responded each time and sealed the win with a late strike from Bellingham.

programme.title: Project One

programme.title: Project One
programme.desc: 'S24/E3 of 3 - Episode 3: Milestone In Automotive History'. Mercedes may have bitten off more than it can chew as certification may not even be possible. Delivery is now years overdue and might not actually be possible.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Australian GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Louis Vuitton Australian Grand Prix'. The Australian GP was the chaotic season opener, won by McLaren's Lando Norris from pole position after a dramatic race marked by mixed weather and multiple safety cars

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Chinese GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Heineken Chinese Grand Prix'. Oscar Piastri won the Chinese main race from pole position, leading a McLaren one-two finish ahead of teammate Lando Norris.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Japan GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Lenovo Japanese Grand Prix'. The Japanese GP was won by Max Verstappen, who fended off a race-long challenge from the two McLarens of Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Bahrain GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Bahrain Grand Prix'. Oscar Piastri of McLaren converted his pole position to a victory, ahead of George Russell of Mercedes and Piastri's teammate Lando Norris.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Saudi Arabia GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - STC Saudi Arabian Grand Prix'. Oscar Piastri won the 2025 Saudi Arabian GP, taking the WDC lead for McLaren. Verstappen took P2 despite a 5s penalty, with Leclerc P3.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Miami GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Crypto.com Miami Grand Prix'. Piastri storms to victory at the 2025 Miami GP, leading a McLaren 1-2 with Norris. Russell takes third as Verstappen slips to fourth after losing the lead on lap 14.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Emilia-Romagna GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - AWS Gran Premio Del Made in Italy E Dell'Emilia-Romagna'. Verstappen triumphs at Imola, winning the Emilia-Romagna GP ahead of Norris and Piastri.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Monaco GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Grand Prix De Monaco'. Norris won from pole, holding off Leclerc. Piastri P3. Verstappen P4 after a late tire gamble failed. Norris's win cut the title lead to 3 points in a strategic race.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Spanish GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Aramco Gran Premio De Espana'. Oscar Piastri controlled the race from pole position, leading a strong showing by McLaren. Lando Norris finished just a few seconds behind.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Canada GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Pirelli Grand Prix Du Canada'. Russell claims pole-to-flag win in Montreal, with Verstappen second and rookie Antonelli third. Russell nabbed fastest lap, McLaren's Norris and Piastri collide late.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Austrian GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - MSC Cruises Austrian Grand Prix'. Norris won at the Red Bull Ring. Piastri P2 ensured McLaren dominance on Red Bull's turf with Leclerc finishing P3.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: British GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Qatar Airways British Grand Prix'. Norris won a wet-dry home GP. Piastri P2, with Hulkenberg a shock P3 for Sauber.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Belgian GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Belgian Grand Prix'. Piastri won at Spa. Norris P2, Leclerc P3. McLaren extended their Constructors' lead significantly over Red Bull.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Hungarian GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Lenovo Hungarian Grand Prix'. Lando Norris wins for McLaren, narrowly beating his teammate Oscar Piastri in a thrilling finish, marking McLaren's 200th F1 win.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Netherlands GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Heineken Dutch Grand Prix'. Piastri spoiled Verstappen's home party with a win. Verstappen P2, Hadjar a shock P3 for RB.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Italy GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Pirelli Gran Premio D'Italia'. Verstappen won at Monza. Norris P2, Piastri P3. Ferrari missed the home podium as Leclerc finished P4.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Azerbaijan GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Qatar Airways Azerbaijan Grand Prix'. Verstappen mastered the Baku streets to win from pole. Russell P2, while Carlos Sainz took a maiden Williams podium in P3.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Singapore GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Singapore Airlines Singapore Grand Prix'. George Russell converted pole into a brilliant win. Verstappen took P2 after holding off a fierce charge from Norris (P3).

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: United States GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - MSC Cruises United States Grand Prix'. Verstappen dominated the weekend, winning both the Sprint and the Grand Prix. Norris beat Leclerc to P2 after a thrilling late-race duel.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Mexico GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Gran Premio De La Ciudad De Mexico'. Norris won from pole, Leclerc took P2, while Verstappen fought from P5 to P3. Rookie Ollie Bearman secured a career-best P4 for Haas.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Sao Paulo GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - MSC Cruises Grande Premio De Sao Paulo'. Norris mastered the rain at Interlagos to win both the Sprint and Grand Prix. Kimi Antonelli took a sensational P2 for Mercedes, with Verstappen P3.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Las Vegas GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Heineken Las Vegas Grand Prix'. Verstappen won a cold, chaotic night race. Russell and Antonelli followed for a Mercedes 2-3. Both McLarens were disqualified for technical infringements.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Qatar GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Qatar Airways Qatar Grand Prix'. Verstappen won again after a McLaren strategy blunder. Piastri took P2 and Carlos Sainz scored a podium for Williams in P3.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Abu Dhabi GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Etihad Airways Abu Dhabi Grand Prix'. Verstappen won the race, but Norris's P3 was enough to secure the World Championship by just 2 points.
